# MonacoLabs.Presto

> A .NET animation library ported from anime.js v4.5.0: a framework-agnostic engine (timers, animations, timelines, stagger, eases) plus an Avalonia adapter that makes controls first-class targets. Packages target net10.0.

Start with GUIDE.md: it is the complete user manual in one file. The specs are the source of truth for exact behavior.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/stevemonaco/MonacoLabs.Presto/blob/main/README.md): what Presto is, install, a short quick start and a feature index.
- [GUIDE](https://github.com/stevemonaco/MonacoLabs.Presto/blob/main/GUIDE.md): the complete manual, every feature with its API and examples, the anime.js → Presto map and the C# differences.
- [Feature specs](https://github.com/stevemonaco/MonacoLabs.Presto/blob/main/docs/specs/README.md): each feature's requirements, tests and design decisions, one file per feature.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/stevemonaco/MonacoLabs.Presto/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release.

## Optional

- [Architecture](https://github.com/stevemonaco/MonacoLabs.Presto/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): how the engine and the Avalonia bridge are built, project-wide decisions, and the anime.js provenance map.
- [Gallery](https://stevemonaco.github.io/MonacoLabs.Presto/): the sample gallery running in the browser.
